title: Inverse Sum
statementMd:
Given an integer 𝑛>1n>1, and the equation:

1𝑛=1𝑎+1𝑏1n=1a+1b

Find two distinct positive integers 𝑎,𝑏a,b which both satisfy the above equation, and have a minimal sum 𝑎+𝑏a+b.

## Input

- The only line of input consists of one integer 𝑛n (1<𝑛≤1081<n≤108) — the number for the left hand side of the equation.

## Output

Output the best choices for 𝑎a and 𝑏b in ascending order.
